desc.id: Otot tipis yang tersembunyi di antara m. tibialis anterior dan m. extensor digitorum longus di tungkai bawah, dengan tendo yang menonjol di punggung kaki saat ibu jari kaki diangkat. Denyut a. dorsalis pedis teraba tepat di lateral tendo ini.

origin.la: Pars media faciei medialis (anterioris) fibulae et membrana interossea cruris
origin.en: Middle part of the anterior (extensor) surface of the fibula and the interosseous membrane

insertion.la: Facies dorsalis basis phalangis distalis hallucis
insertion.en: Dorsal surface of the base of the distal phalanx of the great toe

action.en: Extends the great toe and helps dorsiflex the foot.
action.id: Ekstensi ibu jari kaki dan membantu dorsifleksi kaki.

clinical.en: Weak extension of the great toe is a sensitive sign of L5 nerve root compression.
clinical.id: Kelemahan ekstensi ibu jari kaki merupakan tanda yang peka untuk kompresi radix L5.

origin: Facies anterior fibulae (pars media) et membrana interossea

desc.en: Narrow deep extensor arising from the distal part of the ulna. Its tendon passes with extensor digitorum through the fourth compartment of the extensor retinaculum and joins the extensor expansion of the index finger on the ulnar side of the extensor digitorum tendon, which lets the index finger point on its own.
desc.id: Otot ekstensor dalam yang sempit, berasal dari bagian distal ulna. Tendonya bersama m. extensor digitorum melalui kompartemen keempat retinaculum musculorum extensorum, lalu bergabung dengan aponeurosis dorsalis jari telunjuk di sisi ulnar tendo m. extensor digitorum, sehingga jari telunjuk dapat menunjuk secara mandiri.

group.en: Posterior compartment of forearm, deep layer
group.id: Otot regio antebrachii kompartemen posterior, lapisan profunda

origin.la: Facies posterior tertiae distalis ulnae et membrana interossea antebrachii
origin.en: Posterior surface of the distal third of the ulna and the interosseous membrane

insertion.la: Aponeurosis dorsalis digiti II (indicis)
insertion.en: Extensor expansion of the index finger (second digit)

action.en: Extends the index finger, letting it move independently of the other fingers, and helps extend the hand at the wrist.
action.id: Ekstensi jari telunjuk sehingga jari ini dapat bergerak terpisah dari jari lain, serta membantu ekstensi tangan pada pergelangan tangan.

note.en: The module calls the index finger 'jari I'. The index finger is digit II; digit I is the thumb.
note.id: Modul menyebut jari telunjuk sebagai 'jari I'. Jari telunjuk adalah jari II; jari I adalah ibu jari.

origin: Facies posterior ulnae et membrana interossea
permukaan posterior ulna dan membrana interossea

desc.en: Small deep extensor lying just distal and medial to abductor pollicis longus, whose tendon it follows through the first compartment of the extensor retinaculum. Its tendon forms part of the anterior border of the anatomical snuffbox and ends on the proximal phalanx of the thumb.
desc.id: Otot ekstensor dalam yang kecil, terletak tepat di distal dan medial m. abductor pollicis longus dan mengikuti tendonya melalui kompartemen pertama retinaculum musculorum extensorum. Tendonya ikut membentuk batas anterior fovea radialis (anatomical snuffbox) dan berakhir pada phalanx proximalis ibu jari.

group.en: Posterior compartment of forearm, deep layer
group.id: Otot regio antebrachii kompartemen posterior, lapisan profunda

origin.la: Facies posterior tertiae distalis radii et membrana interossea antebrachii
origin.en: Posterior surface of the distal third of the radius and the interosseous membrane

insertion.la: Basis phalangis proximalis pollicis (facies dorsalis)
insertion.en: Dorsal surface of the base of the proximal phalanx of the thumb

action.en: Extends the proximal phalanx of the thumb at the metacarpophalangeal joint and helps extend the carpometacarpal joint.
action.id: Ekstensi phalanx proximalis ibu jari pada sendi metacarpophalangea dan membantu ekstensi sendi carpometacarpalis.

origin: Facies posterior radii et membrana interossea
permukaan posterior radius dan membrana interossea
action: ekstensi ibu jari pada sendi metacarpophalangeal

desc.en: Deep extensor arising from the ulna. Its tendon runs alone through the third compartment of the extensor retinaculum, hooks around the medial side of the dorsal tubercle of the radius, which acts as a pulley, and then forms the posterior (medial) border of the anatomical snuffbox on its way to the distal phalanx of the thumb.
desc.id: Otot ekstensor dalam yang berasal dari ulna. Tendonya berjalan sendiri melalui kompartemen ketiga retinaculum musculorum extensorum, membelok mengitari sisi medial tuberculum dorsale radii yang berfungsi sebagai katrol, lalu membentuk batas posterior (medial) fovea radialis (anatomical snuffbox) dalam perjalanannya menuju phalanx distalis ibu jari.

group.en: Posterior compartment of forearm, deep layer
group.id: Otot regio antebrachii kompartemen posterior, lapisan profunda

origin.la: Facies posterior tertiae mediae ulnae et membrana interossea antebrachii
origin.en: Posterior surface of the middle third of the ulna and the interosseous membrane

insertion.la: Basis phalangis distalis pollicis (facies dorsalis)
insertion.en: Dorsal surface of the base of the distal phalanx of the thumb

action.en: Extends the distal phalanx of the thumb at the interphalangeal joint and also extends the metacarpophalangeal and carpometacarpal joints. Once the thumb is extended, it draws it back toward the index finger.
action.id: Ekstensi phalanx distalis ibu jari pada sendi interphalangea serta ekstensi sendi metacarpophalangea dan carpometacarpalis. Setelah ibu jari terekstensi, otot ini menariknya ke belakang mendekati jari telunjuk.

clinical.en: The tendon can fray and rupture where it turns around the dorsal tubercle, weeks after a fracture of the distal radius or in rheumatoid arthritis. The patient can then no longer straighten the tip of the thumb.
clinical.id: Tendo ini dapat aus dan putus di tempat tendo membelok mengitari tuberculum dorsale radii, beberapa minggu setelah fraktur radius distal atau pada artritis reumatoid. Pasien kemudian tidak dapat lagi meluruskan ujung ibu jari.

note.en: The module lists extension of the 'distal interphalangeal' joint of the thumb. The thumb has a single interphalangeal joint, and that is the joint this muscle extends.
note.id: Modul menyebut ekstensi sendi 'interphalangeal distal' ibu jari. Ibu jari hanya memiliki satu sendi interphalangea, dan sendi itulah yang diekstensikan oleh otot ini.

origin: Facies posterior ulnae et membrana interossea
permukaan posterior ulna dan membrana interossea
action: ekstensi ibu jari pada sendi interphalangeal dan metacarpophalangeal

desc.en: Strong transverse band of the antebrachial fascia across the back of the wrist, attached laterally to the distal radius and medially to the pisiform and triquetrum, near the ulnar styloid process. Septa from its deep surface to the radius and ulna make six tunnels for the extensor tendons and their synovial sheaths.
desc.id: Pita melintang yang kuat dari fascia antebrachii di punggung pergelangan tangan, melekat di lateral pada radius distal dan di medial pada os pisiforme dan os triquetrum, dekat processus styloideus ulnae. Septa dari permukaan dalamnya ke radius dan ulna membentuk enam terowongan untuk tendo-tendo ekstensor beserta selubung sinovialnya.

attach.en: Laterally the distal end of the radius; medially the pisiform and triquetrum
attach.id: Di lateral ujung distal radius; di medial os pisiforme dan os triquetrum

compartments: I: M. abductor pollicis longus, M. extensor pollicis brevis
II: M. extensor carpi radialis longus, M. extensor carpi radialis brevis
IV: M. extensor digitorum, M. extensor indicis

function.en: Holds the extensor tendons against the radius and ulna so they do not bowstring when the wrist is extended.
function.id: Menahan tendo-tendo ekstensor tetap dekat dengan radius dan ulna agar tidak terangkat seperti tali busur saat pergelangan tangan diekstensikan.

desc.en: Lateral terminal branch of a. iliaca communis, running from the front of the articulatio sacroiliaca along the pelvic brim to the ligamentum inguinale, where it becomes a. femoralis.
desc.id: Cabang terminal lateral a. iliaca communis yang berjalan dari depan articulatio sacroiliaca di sepanjang pintu atas panggul sampai ligamentum inguinale, tempat arteri menjadi a. femoralis.

course.en: Descends along the medial border of m. psoas major, with v. iliaca externa medial and then posterior to it. Just above the ligamentum inguinale it gives a. epigastrica inferior and a. circumflexa ilium profunda, then passes under the ligament at the mid-inguinal point, midway between the spina iliaca anterior superior and the symphysis pubica.
course.id: Turun di sepanjang tepi medial m. psoas major, dengan v. iliaca externa di medial lalu di belakangnya. Tepat di atas ligamentum inguinale arteri memberikan a. epigastrica inferior dan a. circumflexa ilium profunda, lalu lewat di bawah ligamentum di titik mid-inguinal, di pertengahan antara spina iliaca anterior superior dan symphysis pubica.

supplies.en: The lower limb and, through its branches, the lower anterior abdominal wall and the iliac fossa.
supplies.id: Ekstremitas inferior dan, melalui cabang-cabangnya, dinding perut anterior bagian bawah serta fossa iliaca.

desc.en: Continuation of v. femoralis above the ligamentum inguinale. It runs up along the linea terminalis with a. iliaca externa and joins v. iliaca interna in front of the articulatio sacroiliaca to form v. iliaca communis.
desc.id: Lanjutan v. femoralis di atas ligamentum inguinale. Vena ini naik di sepanjang linea terminalis bersama a. iliaca externa dan bergabung dengan v. iliaca interna di depan articulatio sacroiliaca membentuk v. iliaca communis.

course.en: Begins behind the ligamentum inguinale, medial to a. iliaca externa. On the right it lies medial to the artery at first and gradually passes behind it as it ascends; on the left it stays medial to the artery. It runs along the medial border of m. psoas major, covered by peritoneum.
course.id: Dimulai di belakang ligamentum inguinale, di medial a. iliaca externa. Di sisi kanan vena mula-mula berada di medial arteri lalu perlahan berpindah ke belakangnya saat naik; di sisi kiri vena tetap di medial arteri. Vena berjalan di sepanjang tepi medial m. psoas major dan ditutupi peritoneum.

drains.en: The whole lower limb through v. femoralis, and the lower anterior abdominal wall through v. epigastrica inferior and v. circumflexa ilium profunda.
drains.id: Seluruh ekstremitas inferior melalui v. femoralis, serta dinding perut anterior bagian bawah melalui v. epigastrica inferior dan v. circumflexa ilium profunda.

en: External branch of superior laryngeal nerve

desc.en: Thin motor branch that descends on the inferior pharyngeal constrictor close to the superior thyroid artery and ends in the cricothyroid muscle.
desc.id: Cabang motorik tipis yang turun di atas m. constrictor pharyngis inferior berdekatan dengan a. thyroidea superior dan berakhir di m. cricothyroideus.

course.en: Runs with the superior thyroid artery toward the upper pole of the thyroid gland, then to the cricothyroid.
course.id: Berjalan bersama a. thyroidea superior menuju kutub atas glandula thyroidea, lalu ke m. cricothyroideus.

lesion.en: Cricothyroid paralysis: the vocal fold cannot be tensed, the voice is weak and high notes are lost.
lesion.id: Kelumpuhan m. cricothyroideus: plica vocalis tidak dapat ditegangkan, suara lemah dan nada tinggi hilang.

desc.en: The pyramid-shaped projection of the face with a bony upper part (nasal bones, maxillae) and a cartilaginous lower part (septal and alar cartilages).
desc.id: Tonjolan wajah berbentuk piramida dengan kerangka tulang di bagian atas (ossa nasalia, maxillae) dan kerangka tulang rawan di bagian bawah (cartilago septi nasi dan cartilagines alares).

desc.en: A midline ridge from the external occipital protuberance down to the foramen magnum; the nuchal ligament attaches to it.
desc.id: Rigi di garis tengah dari protuberantia occipitalis externa ke foramen magnum; tempat melekat ligamentum nuchae.

desc.en: The midline bump at the back of the skull, whose highest point is the inion; the nuchal ligament and trapezius attach here.
desc.id: Tonjolan di garis tengah bagian belakang tengkorak, titik tertingginya disebut inion; tempat melekat ligamentum nuchae dan m. trapezius.

desc.en: The outer, lateral bulk of the thyroarytenoid muscle, lying lateral to the vocalis and the vocal ligament. It runs from the thyroid angle to the anterolateral surface of the arytenoid.
desc.id: Bagian luar (lateral) m. thyroarytenoideus yang terletak di lateral m. vocalis dan lig. vocale. Bagian ini berjalan dari sudut cartilago thyroidea ke facies anterolateralis arytenoidea.

origin.la: Facies interna anguli cartilaginis thyroideae
origin.en: Inner surface of the thyroid angle

insertion.la: Facies anterolateralis cartilaginis arytenoideae
insertion.en: Anterolateral surface of the arytenoid

desc.en: Small superficial veins that accompany the aa. pudendae externae. They drain the skin of the pubic region and the anterior part of the external genitalia and end in v. saphena magna near the hiatus saphenus.
desc.id: Vena superfisial kecil yang menyertai aa. pudendae externae. Vena ini mengalirkan darah dari kulit regio pubica dan bagian anterior genitalia eksterna lalu bermuara ke v. saphena magna di dekat hiatus saphenus.

drains.en: Skin of the pubic region, the anterior scrotum or labia majora and, through the superficial dorsal veins, the skin of the penis or clitoris.
drains.id: Kulit regio pubica, bagian anterior scrotum atau labia majora dan, melalui vv. dorsales superficiales, kulit penis atau clitoris.

desc.en: The convex outer surface, crossed by the temporal lines and raised at the parietal eminence.
desc.id: Permukaan luar yang cembung, dilintasi linea temporalis dan menonjol pada tuber parietale.

desc.en: The smooth convex outer surface of the frontal squama that shapes the forehead.
desc.id: Permukaan luar squama frontalis yang cembung dan halus, membentuk dahi.

desc.en: The two movable folds that cover and protect the front of the eyeball; each contains a tarsal plate and fibres of the orbicularis oculi.
desc.id: Dua lipatan yang dapat bergerak untuk menutup dan melindungi bagian depan bola mata; masing-masing berisi tarsus dan serabut m. orbicularis oculi.

la: Facies articularis partis calcaneonavicularis ligamenti bifurcati
en: Facet for calcaneonavicular part of bifurcate ligament

desc.en: Small facet on the lateral part of the head of the talus.
desc.id: Faset kecil pada bagian lateral caput tali.

attach.en: Contacts the calcaneonavicular part of the bifurcate ligament, which lines the socket of the talocalcaneonavicular joint on the lateral side.
attach.id: Bersentuhan dengan pars calcaneonavicularis lig. bifurcati yang melapisi soket articulatio talocalcaneonavicularis di sisi lateral.

desc.en: An oval facet on the back of the anterior arch of the atlas that articulates with the anterior facet of the dens (median atlanto-axial joint).
desc.id: Fovea lonjong di permukaan belakang arcus anterior atlantis yang bersendi dengan facies articularis anterior dentis (articulatio atlantoaxialis mediana).

alt: Facies articularis ligamenti calcaneonavicularis plantaris tali

desc.en: Facet on the plantar medial part of the head of the talus, between the navicular surface and the anterior calcaneal facet.
desc.id: Faset pada bagian plantar medial caput tali, di antara facies articularis navicularis dan facies articularis calcanea anterior.

attach.en: Rests on the plantar calcaneonavicular (spring) ligament.
attach.id: Bertumpu pada lig. calcaneonaviculare plantare (spring ligament).

desc.en: Strong deep fascia that wraps the thigh like a stocking. Its lateral part is thickened as the iliotibial tract, and the great saphenous vein passes through an opening in it (hiatus saphenus) just below the inguinal ligament.
desc.id: Fascia profunda yang kuat, membungkus paha seperti kaus kaki panjang. Bagian lateralnya menebal menjadi tractus iliotibialis, dan v. saphena magna menembusnya melalui sebuah lubang (hiatus saphenus) tepat di bawah ligamentum inguinale.

location.en: Deep fascia of the thigh and gluteal region
location.id: Fascia profunda paha dan regio glutea

attach.en: Above: inguinal ligament, pubis, ischiopubic ramus, ischial tuberosity, sacrotuberous ligament, sacrum, coccyx and iliac crest. Below: the bony prominences around the knee, continuing as the crural fascia.
attach.id: Di atas: ligamentum inguinale, os pubis, ramus ischiopubicus, tuber ischiadicum, ligamentum sacrotuberale, sacrum, coccyx dan crista iliaca. Di bawah: tonjolan tulang di sekitar lutut, lalu berlanjut sebagai fascia cruris.

function.en: Holds the thigh muscles in place and sends intermuscular septa to the linea aspera that separate the compartments of the thigh.
function.id: Menahan otot-otot paha pada tempatnya dan memberikan septa intermuscularia ke linea aspera yang memisahkan kompartemen paha.

desc.en: Main artery of the lower limb, continuing a. iliaca externa below the ligamentum inguinale. It descends through the trigonum femorale and the canalis adductorius and becomes a. poplitea at the hiatus adductorius.
desc.id: Arteri utama ekstremitas inferior, lanjutan a. iliaca externa di bawah ligamentum inguinale. Arteri ini turun melalui trigonum femorale dan canalis adductorius, lalu menjadi a. poplitea di hiatus adductorius.

course.en: Enters the thigh behind the ligamentum inguinale at the mid-inguinal point, in the lateral compartment of the femoral sheath, with v. femoralis medial to it and n. femoralis lateral to it outside the sheath. It descends through the trigonum femorale to its apex, runs in the canalis adductorius under m. sartorius together with v. femoralis and n. saphenus, and passes through the hiatus adductorius in m. adductor magnus to become a. poplitea.
course.id: Masuk ke paha di belakang ligamentum inguinale pada titik mid-inguinal, di kompartemen lateral vagina vasorum femoralium, dengan v. femoralis di medialnya dan n. femoralis di lateralnya di luar selubung. Arteri turun melalui trigonum femorale sampai puncaknya, berjalan di canalis adductorius di bawah m. sartorius bersama v. femoralis dan n. saphenus, lalu melewati hiatus adductorius pada m. adductor magnus dan menjadi a. poplitea.

supplies.en: The thigh, the lower anterior abdominal wall and external genitalia (superficial branches) and, through a. poplitea, the leg and foot.
supplies.id: Paha, dinding perut anterior bagian bawah dan genitalia eksterna (cabang superfisial) serta, melalui a. poplitea, tungkai bawah dan kaki.

clinical.en: The femoral pulse is felt just below the ligamentum inguinale at the mid-inguinal point. It is the common entry site for arterial catheters in angiography and coronary interventions; v. femoralis lies just medial to the pulse for venous access. Its superficial position in the trigonum femorale makes wounds there dangerous.
clinical.id: Denyut a. femoralis diraba tepat di bawah ligamentum inguinale pada titik mid-inguinal. Arteri ini tempat masuk kateter yang lazim pada angiografi dan intervensi koroner; v. femoralis terletak tepat di medial denyut untuk akses vena. Letaknya yang superfisial di trigonum femorale membuat luka di daerah ini berbahaya.

desc.en: Passes behind the ligamentum inguinale lateral to a. femoralis within the femoral sheath, then pierces the sheath and the fascia lata to supply the skin over the upper part of the trigonum femorale.
desc.id: Berjalan di belakang ligamentum inguinale di lateral a. femoralis di dalam vagina vasorum femoralium, lalu menembus selubung tersebut dan fascia lata untuk mempersarafi kulit di atas bagian atas trigonum femorale.

sensory.en: Skin of the upper anterior thigh over the trigonum femorale.
sensory.id: Kulit paha atas bagian anterior di atas trigonum femorale.

desc.en: Largest branch of the lumbar plexus and the nerve of the anterior compartment of the thigh. It enters the thigh under the ligamentum inguinale, lateral to a. femoralis and outside the femoral sheath, and supplies m. quadriceps femoris.
desc.id: Cabang terbesar plexus lumbalis dan saraf kompartemen anterior paha. Saraf ini masuk ke paha di bawah ligamentum inguinale, di lateral a. femoralis dan di luar vagina vasorum femoralium, lalu mempersarafi m. quadriceps femoris.

course.en: Formed in m. psoas major from the posterior divisions of L2-L4. It emerges at the lateral border of the muscle and descends in the groove between m. psoas major and m. iliacus, deep to the fascia iliaca, supplying m. iliacus. It passes under the ligamentum inguinale through the lacuna musculorum, lateral to a. femoralis and outside the femoral sheath (from lateral to medial: nerve, artery, vein, lymphatics). A few centimetres below the ligament, in the trigonum femorale, it breaks up into muscular branches, rami cutanei anteriores and n. saphenus.
course.id: Terbentuk di dalam m. psoas major dari divisio posterior L2-L4. Saraf keluar di tepi lateral otot dan turun di alur antara m. psoas major dan m. iliacus, di bawah fascia iliaca, sambil mempersarafi m. iliacus. Saraf lewat di bawah ligamentum inguinale melalui lacuna musculorum, di lateral a. femoralis dan di luar vagina vasorum femoralium (dari lateral ke medial: saraf, arteri, vena, pembuluh limfe). Beberapa sentimeter di bawah ligamentum, di trigonum femorale, saraf pecah menjadi cabang muskular, rami cutanei anteriores dan n. saphenus.

sensory.en: Skin of the anterior and medial thigh (rami cutanei anteriores) and of the medial leg and medial border of the foot (n. saphenus).
sensory.id: Kulit paha bagian anterior dan medial (rami cutanei anteriores) serta kulit sisi medial tungkai bawah dan tepi medial kaki (n. saphenus).

lesion.en: Injured by pelvic or hip surgery, retroperitoneal haematoma, femoral catheterisation or wounds in the trigonum femorale. M. quadriceps femoris is paralysed: the knee cannot be extended against resistance and buckles when walking, especially downstairs; the patellar reflex (L3-L4) is lost, hip flexion is weak, and sensation is lost on the anterior thigh and medial leg.
lesion.id: Dapat cedera pada operasi pelvis atau panggul, hematoma retroperitoneal, kateterisasi femoral atau luka di trigonum femorale. M. quadriceps femoris lumpuh: lutut tidak dapat diekstensikan melawan tahanan dan tertekuk saat berjalan, terutama saat menuruni tangga; refleks patella (L3-L4) hilang, fleksi panggul lemah, dan sensasi hilang di paha depan serta sisi medial tungkai bawah.

note.en: The module gives its origin as L1-4; standard references (Moore, Gray's) give L2-L4.
note.id: Modul menyebut asalnya L1-4; rujukan standar (Moore, Gray's) menyebut L2-L4.

desc.en: Main deep vein of the thigh. It continues v. poplitea at the hiatus adductorius, ascends through the canalis adductorius and the trigonum femorale with a. femoralis, and becomes v. iliaca externa behind the ligamentum inguinale.
desc.id: Vena dalam utama paha. Vena ini melanjutkan v. poplitea di hiatus adductorius, naik melalui canalis adductorius dan trigonum femorale bersama a. femoralis, lalu menjadi v. iliaca externa di belakang ligamentum inguinale.

course.en: In the canalis adductorius it lies posterolateral and then posterior to a. femoralis; at the apex of the trigonum femorale it is behind the artery, and at the base of the triangle it is medial to it. Below the ligamentum inguinale it occupies the intermediate compartment of the femoral sheath, with the artery lateral to it and the canalis femoralis medial to it (from lateral to medial: nerve, artery, vein, empty space, lymphatics). In the lower part of the trigonum femorale it receives v. profunda femoris, and just below the ligamentum inguinale it receives v. saphena magna.
course.id: Di canalis adductorius vena ini terletak di posterolateral lalu di posterior a. femoralis; di apex trigonum femorale berada di belakang arteri, dan di basis trigonum berada di medialnya. Di bawah ligamentum inguinale vena menempati kompartemen tengah selubung femoral (femoral sheath), dengan arteri di lateralnya dan canalis femoralis di medialnya (dari lateral ke medial: nervus, arteri, vena, ruang kosong, limfatik). Di bagian bawah trigonum femorale vena menerima v. profunda femoris, dan tepat di bawah ligamentum inguinale menerima v. saphena magna.

drains.en: Nearly the whole lower limb: all the deep veins and, through v. saphena magna, most of the superficial veins. The gluteal region drains separately into v. iliaca interna.
drains.id: Hampir seluruh ekstremitas inferior: semua vena dalam dan, melalui v. saphena magna, sebagian besar vena superfisial. Regio glutea mengalir terpisah ke v. iliaca interna.

clinical.en: Femoral venous puncture or central line: feel the femoral pulse just below the ligamentum inguinale and insert the needle about 1 cm medial to it. Thrombosis here is a proximal DVT with a high risk of pulmonary embolism. Ultrasound reports often call the part below the profunda junction the superficial femoral vein; it is still a deep vein, and a clot in it is a DVT.
clinical.id: Pungsi vena femoralis atau pemasangan kateter vena sentral: raba denyut a. femoralis tepat di bawah ligamentum inguinale dan tusukkan jarum kira-kira 1 cm di medialnya. Trombosis di sini termasuk DVT proksimal dengan risiko emboli paru yang tinggi. Laporan USG sering menyebut bagian di bawah muara v. profunda femoris sebagai superficial femoral vein; vena ini tetap vena dalam, dan bekuan di dalamnya adalah DVT.

desc.en: Longest and strongest bone of the body and the only bone of the thigh. Its head fits the acetabulum at the hip joint, and its two condyles rest on the tibia at the knee joint, with the patella gliding on the front of the lower end.
desc.id: Tulang terpanjang dan terkuat di tubuh, satu-satunya tulang paha. Caput femoris masuk ke acetabulum membentuk articulatio coxae, sedangkan kedua condylus bertumpu pada tibia membentuk articulatio genus, dengan patella meluncur di depan ujung bawahnya.

clinical.en: Femoral neck fractures are common in elderly women with osteoporosis. The leg lies shortened and laterally rotated, and a displaced fracture can tear the retinacular arteries along the neck, leading to avascular necrosis of the head.
clinical.id: Fraktur collum femoris sering terjadi pada perempuan lanjut usia dengan osteoporosis. Tungkai tampak memendek dan berotasi ke lateral, dan fraktur yang bergeser dapat merobek arteri retinakular di sepanjang collum sehingga caput femoris mengalami nekrosis avaskular.

note.en: The neck meets the shaft at an angle of inclination of about 125° in adults. A smaller angle is coxa vara, a larger one coxa valga.
note.id: Collum membentuk sudut inklinasi sekitar 125° terhadap corpus pada orang dewasa. Sudut yang lebih kecil disebut coxa vara, yang lebih besar coxa valga.

desc.en: Terminologia Anatomica groups three ligaments of the scapula as syndesmoses of the pectoral girdle: the coracoacromial ligament and the superior and inferior transverse scapular ligaments. Each joins two parts of the same bone, so they allow no movement; they form an arch over the shoulder joint and bridges over nerves and vessels.
desc.id: Terminologia Anatomica mengelompokkan tiga ligamentum scapula sebagai syndesmosis gelang bahu: lig. coracoacromiale, lig. transversum scapulae superius dan lig. transversum scapulae inferius. Masing-masing menghubungkan dua bagian dari tulang yang sama sehingga tidak menghasilkan gerakan; ligamentum ini membentuk lengkung di atas sendi bahu serta jembatan di atas saraf dan pembuluh darah.

note.en: The coracoclavicular ligament, which joins the clavicle to the scapula, is also a syndesmosis by structure; TA98 lists it with the acromioclavicular joint.
note.id: Lig. coracoclaviculare, yang menghubungkan clavicula dengan scapula, secara struktur juga merupakan syndesmosis; TA98 memasukkannya ke sendi acromioclavicularis.

desc.en: Slender lateral bone of the leg that carries little of the body weight. Its shaft gives attachment to many leg muscles, and its lower end, the lateral malleolus, forms the lateral side of the ankle joint.
desc.id: Tulang ramping di sisi lateral tungkai bawah yang hanya menanggung sedikit berat badan. Corpus-nya menjadi tempat lekat banyak otot tungkai bawah, dan ujung bawahnya, malleolus lateralis, membentuk sisi lateral sendi pergelangan kaki.

clinical.en: The common fibular nerve winds around the neck of the fibula, where a fracture or a tight cast can injure it and cause foot drop. A segment of the shaft can be removed with its vessels and used as a bone graft without disturbing walking.
clinical.id: N. fibularis communis melingkari collum fibulae; di tempat ini fraktur atau gips yang terlalu ketat dapat mencederainya dan menimbulkan foot drop. Sebagian corpus fibulae dapat diambil bersama pembuluh darahnya sebagai cangkok tulang tanpa mengganggu kemampuan berjalan.

desc.en: Largest branch of a. tibialis posterior. It descends behind the fibula, within or behind m. flexor hallucis longus, and ends in calcaneal branches behind the malleolus lateralis.
desc.id: Cabang terbesar a. tibialis posterior. Arteri ini turun di belakang fibula, di dalam atau di belakang m. flexor hallucis longus, dan berakhir sebagai rami calcanei di belakang malleolus lateralis.

course.en: Arises a few centimetres below the lower border of m. popliteus and descends toward the fibula along its posterior surface.
course.id: Berasal beberapa sentimeter di bawah tepi bawah m. popliteus dan turun menuju fibula di sepanjang permukaan posteriornya.

supplies.en: The deep posterior and the lateral compartment muscles, the fibula, the lateral ankle and the heel.
supplies.id: Otot kompartemen posterior lapisan dalam dan kompartemen lateral, fibula, pergelangan kaki sisi lateral dan tumit.

clinical.en: Its perforating branch can replace a small a. dorsalis pedis. The fibula with this artery is used as a free bone flap, for example in jaw reconstruction.
clinical.id: Ramus perforans-nya dapat menggantikan a. dorsalis pedis yang kecil. Fibula beserta arteri ini dipakai sebagai flap tulang bebas, misalnya pada rekonstruksi rahang.

desc.en: Small flat facet on the posterolateral underside of the lateral tibial condyle.
desc.id: Faset kecil dan datar pada sisi bawah posterolateral condylus lateralis tibiae.

attach.en: Articulates with the head of the fibula at the superior tibiofibular joint; the capsule attaches around it.
attach.id: Bersendi dengan caput fibulae pada articulatio tibiofibularis; capsula articularis melekat di sekelilingnya.

desc.en: Round, cord-like ligament on the lateral side of the knee, separate from the capsule.
desc.id: Ligamen bulat seperti tali di sisi lateral lutut yang terpisah dari capsula articularis.

attach.en: Lateral epicondyle of the femur to the lateral surface of the head of the fibula; the biceps femoris tendon splits around its lower end.
attach.id: Epicondylus lateralis femoris ke permukaan lateral caput fibulae; tendo m. biceps femoris terbelah mengapit ujung bawahnya.

function.en: Resists varus (adduction) stress and is tight in extension. The popliteus tendon passes deep to it and separates it from the lateral meniscus.
function.id: Menahan tekanan varus (adduksi) dan tegang saat ekstensi. Tendo m. popliteus lewat di bawahnya dan memisahkannya dari meniscus lateralis.

desc.en: Concave notch on the lateral side of the lower end of the tibia that receives the lower end of the fibula.
desc.id: Takik cekung pada sisi lateral ujung bawah tibia yang menerima ujung bawah fibula.

attach.en: Interosseous tibiofibular ligament; the anterior and posterior tibiofibular ligaments attach to its edges.
attach.id: Lig. tibiofibulare interosseum; lig. tibiofibulare anterius dan posterius melekat pada tepinya.

desc.en: Synovial sheaths of the fibularis longus and brevis tendons on the lateral side of the ankle and in the sole.
desc.id: Selubung sinovial tendo m. fibularis longus dan brevis di sisi lateral pergelangan kaki dan di telapak kaki.

location.en: Behind and below the lateral malleolus, and across the sole
location.id: Di belakang dan bawah malleolus lateralis, serta menyilang telapak kaki

desc.en: Paired venae comitantes of the a. fibularis, lying close to the fibula in the deep posterior compartment of the leg. They end in the vv. tibiales posteriores in the upper part of the leg.
desc.id: Venae comitantes berpasangan dari a. fibularis, terletak dekat fibula di kompartemen posterior profunda tungkai bawah. Vena ini bermuara ke vv. tibiales posteriores di bagian atas tungkai bawah.

course.en: Ascend with the artery close to the fibula and behind the membrana interossea cruris, covered by m. flexor hallucis longus, and end in the posterior tibial veins in the upper third of the leg.
course.id: Naik bersama arteri dekat fibula di belakang membrana interossea cruris, tertutup oleh m. flexor hallucis longus, lalu bermuara ke vv. tibiales posteriores di sepertiga atas tungkai bawah.

drains.en: Muscles of the lateral part of the posterior compartment and of the lateral compartment of the leg, and the fibula.
drains.id: Otot-otot bagian lateral kompartemen posterior dan kompartemen lateral tungkai bawah, serta fibula.

clinical.en: Together with the posterior tibial veins and the veins of m. soleus they are the usual starting site of DVT in the calf.
clinical.id: Bersama vv. tibiales posteriores dan vena m. soleus, vena ini merupakan tempat awal DVT yang paling sering di betis.

desc.en: Deeper and shorter muscle of the lateral compartment. Its tendon runs behind the lateral malleolus in front of the fibularis longus tendon and ends on the tuberosity of the fifth metatarsal, which an inversion injury can pull off (avulsion fracture).
desc.id: Otot kompartemen lateral yang lebih dalam dan lebih pendek. Tendonya berjalan di belakang malleolus lateralis, di depan tendo m. fibularis longus, dan berinsersio pada tuberositas ossis metatarsi V, yang dapat tertarik lepas pada cedera inversi (fraktur avulsi).

origin.la: Duae tertiae inferiores faciei lateralis fibulae
origin.en: Lower two-thirds of the lateral surface of the fibula

insertion.la: Tuberositas ossis metatarsi V
insertion.en: Dorsal surface of the tuberosity on the lateral side of the base of the fifth metatarsal

action.en: Everts the foot and weakly plantarflexes it at the ankle.
action.id: Eversi kaki dan plantarfleksi lemah pada sendi talocruralis.

desc.en: Superficial muscle of the lateral compartment, lying over fibularis brevis. Its tendon passes behind the lateral malleolus, turns under the cuboid in a groove and crosses the sole obliquely to the medial side, so it acts as a sling under the arches of the foot.
desc.id: Otot superfisial kompartemen lateral yang terletak di atas m. fibularis brevis. Tendonya berjalan di belakang malleolus lateralis, membelok di bawah os cuboideum dalam sebuah sulcus, lalu menyilang telapak kaki secara miring ke sisi medial, sehingga berfungsi sebagai penyangga di bawah lengkung kaki.

origin.la: Caput fibulae et duae tertiae superiores faciei lateralis fibulae
origin.en: Head of the fibula and upper two-thirds of the lateral surface of the fibula

insertion.la: Basis ossis metatarsi I et os cuneiforme mediale (facies plantaris)
insertion.en: Plantar side of the base of the first metatarsal and the medial cuneiform

action.en: Everts the foot and weakly plantarflexes it at the ankle. It supports the transverse and lateral longitudinal arches.
action.id: Eversi kaki dan plantarfleksi lemah pada sendi talocruralis. Otot ini menopang arcus transversus dan arcus longitudinalis lateralis.

clinical.en: The common fibular nerve winds around the neck of the fibula deep to fibularis longus, where a fracture or a tight cast can injure it. Dorsiflexion and eversion are then lost, and the foot hangs plantarflexed and inverted (foot drop).
clinical.id: N. fibularis communis melingkari collum fibulae di bawah m. fibularis longus, sehingga mudah cedera pada fraktur collum fibulae atau akibat gips yang terlalu ketat. Dorsifleksi dan eversi kaki hilang, dan kaki menggantung dalam posisi plantarfleksi dan inversi (foot drop).

origin: Caput fibulae et facies lateralis fibulae
insertion: Basis ossis metatarsi I et os cuneiforme mediale
basis metatarsal I dan cuneiforme mediale

desc.en: Small, inconstant slip at the lower lateral edge of extensor digitorum longus, often fused with it. Its tendon runs to the base of the fifth metatarsal and can be felt lateral to the extensor tendons when the foot is dorsiflexed and everted.
desc.id: Berkas otot kecil yang tidak selalu ada di tepi lateral bawah m. extensor digitorum longus dan sering menyatu dengannya. Tendonya menuju basis os metatarsi V dan dapat diraba di lateral tendo-tendo ekstensor saat kaki didorsifleksikan dan dieversikan.

origin.la: Tertia inferior faciei medialis (anterioris) fibulae et membrana interossea cruris
origin.en: Lower third of the anterior (extensor) surface of the fibula and the interosseous membrane

insertion.la: Facies dorsalis basis ossis metatarsi V
insertion.en: Dorsum of the base of the fifth metatarsal

action.en: Dorsiflexes the foot and helps evert it.
action.id: Dorsifleksi kaki dan membantu eversi kaki.

desc.en: Metacarpal of the little finger. Its base articulates with the hamate and has a tubercle on its medial side for extensor carpi ulnaris; its fairly mobile carpometacarpal joint helps cup the palm.
desc.id: Os metacarpi jari kelingking. Basisnya bersendi dengan os hamatum dan memiliki tuberculum di sisi medial untuk m. extensor carpi ulnaris; sendi carpometacarpalisnya cukup mudah bergerak sehingga membantu telapak tangan menangkup.

note.en: Base: extensor carpi ulnaris, and flexor carpi ulnaris through the pisometacarpal ligament. Shaft: opponens digiti minimi on the medial border, fourth dorsal interosseous and third palmar interosseous.
note.id: Basis: m. extensor carpi ulnaris, dan m. flexor carpi ulnaris melalui lig. pisometacarpale. Corpus: m. opponens digiti minimi pada tepi medial, m. interosseus dorsalis IV dan m. interosseus palmaris III.

clinical.en: A fracture of its neck after punching a hard object is called a boxer's fracture; the head tilts toward the palm.
clinical.id: Fraktur pada collum-nya akibat meninju benda keras disebut boxer's fracture; caput-nya miring ke arah palmar.

desc.en: Lateral metatarsal with a large tuberosity projecting backward from its base, palpable halfway along the lateral border of the foot.
desc.id: Os metatarsi paling lateral dengan tuberositas besar yang menonjol ke belakang dari basisnya, dapat diraba di pertengahan tepi lateral kaki.

clinical.en: Forced inversion can avulse the tuberosity. A fracture just beyond it, at the junction of base and shaft (Jones fracture), heals poorly because the blood supply there is limited.
clinical.id: Inversi paksa dapat menimbulkan fraktur avulsi tuberositas. Fraktur sedikit di distalnya, di perbatasan basis dan corpus (fraktur Jones), sulit menyatu karena perdarahan di daerah itu terbatas.

note.en: Fibularis brevis inserts on the tuberosity, and fibularis tertius on the dorsum of the base and shaft.
note.id: M. fibularis brevis berinsersio pada tuberositas, dan m. fibularis tertius pada dorsum basis dan corpus.

desc.en: A typical true rib articulating with T4 and T5. The apex of the heart usually lies in the fifth intercostal space, below this rib, in the left midclavicular line.
desc.id: Costa vera tipikal yang bersendi dengan T4 dan T5. Apex cordis biasanya terletak di spatium intercostale V, di bawah costa ini, pada linea medioclavicularis kiri.

desc.en: The shortest and thickest metacarpal, belonging to the thumb. It lies anterior to the plane of the other metacarpals and is turned about 90 degrees, so its saddle joint with the trapezium allows opposition.
desc.id: Os metacarpi yang paling pendek dan paling tebal, milik ibu jari. Letaknya lebih ke anterior daripada metacarpal lain dan terputar sekitar 90 derajat, sehingga sendi pelananya dengan os trapezium memungkinkan gerakan oposisi.

note.en: Base: abductor pollicis longus. Shaft: opponens pollicis on the lateral border and one head of the first dorsal interosseous on the medial side.
note.id: Basis: m. abductor pollicis longus. Corpus: m. opponens pollicis pada tepi lateral dan salah satu caput m. interosseus dorsalis I pada sisi medial.

clinical.en: Bennett fracture is an oblique fracture of the base that enters the carpometacarpal joint; abductor pollicis longus pulls the main fragment proximally.
clinical.id: Fraktur Bennett adalah fraktur oblik pada basis yang masuk ke sendi carpometacarpalis; m. abductor pollicis longus menarik fragmen utama ke proksimal.

desc.en: Shortest and thickest metatarsal, at the base of the great toe. Its head carries much of the load at push-off and has two sesamoid bones on its plantar side.
desc.id: Os metatarsi terpendek dan paling tebal, di pangkal ibu jari kaki. Caput-nya menanggung banyak beban saat kaki menolak tanah dan memiliki dua os sesamoideum di sisi plantarnya.

clinical.en: In hallux valgus the first metatarsal drifts medially and the great toe deviates laterally; a bunion forms over the prominent head.
clinical.id: Pada hallux valgus, os metatarsi I bergeser ke medial dan ibu jari kaki menyimpang ke lateral; bunion terbentuk di atas caput yang menonjol.

note.en: Tibialis anterior inserts on the medial side of its base, and fibularis longus on the tuberosity on the lateral plantar side of the base.
note.id: M. tibialis anterior berinsersio pada sisi medial basisnya, dan m. fibularis longus pada tuberositas di sisi lateral plantar basis.

desc.en: The shortest, broadest and most curved rib, lying flat with upper and lower surfaces. Its head has a single facet for T1. The upper surface carries the scalene tubercle with a groove for the subclavian vein in front of it and a groove for the subclavian artery and lower trunk of the brachial plexus behind it. Its cartilage joins the manubrium by a synchondrosis.
desc.id: Costa terpendek, terlebar, dan paling melengkung, terletak mendatar dengan permukaan atas dan bawah. Caput-nya hanya memiliki satu facies untuk T1. Permukaan atasnya memuat tuberculum musculi scaleni anterioris dengan sulcus venae subclaviae di depannya serta sulcus arteriae subclaviae dan truncus inferior plexus brachialis di belakangnya. Cartilago-nya bersatu dengan manubrium melalui synchondrosis.

clinical.en: A fracture of the first rib signals severe trauma and can injure the subclavian vessels and brachial plexus; an extra cervical rib above it can compress the same structures (thoracic outlet syndrome).
clinical.id: Fraktur costa I menandakan trauma berat dan dapat mencederai pembuluh subclavia serta plexus brachialis; costa cervicalis tambahan di atasnya dapat menekan struktur yang sama (sindrom thoracic outlet).

desc.en: Superficial flexor lying just medial to pronator teres, with a long tendon that stands out at the wrist when the hand is flexed against resistance. The tendon runs in its own canal in the lateral part of the flexor retinaculum, in the groove of the trapezium, outside the carpal tunnel. The radial pulse is felt just lateral to it.
desc.id: Otot fleksor superfisial tepat di medial m. pronator teres, dengan tendo panjang yang menonjol di pergelangan tangan saat tangan difleksikan melawan tahanan. Tendonya berjalan dalam saluran tersendiri di bagian lateral retinaculum musculorum flexorum, pada alur os trapezium, di luar canalis carpi. Denyut a. radialis teraba tepat di lateral tendo ini.

group.en: Anterior compartment of forearm, superficial layer (module: lapis pertama)
group.id: Otot regio antebrachii kompartemen anterior, lapis pertama (superfisial)

origin.la: Epicondylus medialis humeri (origo communis flexorum)
origin.en: Medial epicondyle of the humerus (common flexor origin)

insertion.la: Basis ossis metacarpi II (et III), facies palmaris
insertion.en: Palmar surface of the base of the second metacarpal, with a slip to the third

action.en: Flexes the hand at the wrist and abducts it (radial deviation).
action.id: Fleksi dan abduksi tangan pada pergelangan tangan (deviasi radial).

note.en: The module gives the insertion as the base of the first metacarpal (thumb). Standard references place it on the base of the second metacarpal, with a slip to the third.
note.id: Modul menyebut insersio pada basis metakarpal I (ibu jari). Buku acuan standar menyebut basis os metacarpi II, dengan sebagian serabut ke os metacarpi III.

insertion: basis ossis metacarpi II et III

desc.en: Most medial superficial flexor, with a humeral head from the medial epicondyle and an ulnar head from the olecranon and posterior border of the ulna. The ulnar nerve enters the forearm through the gap between the two heads. Its tendon ends on the pisiform, a sesamoid bone in the tendon, and continues by ligaments to the hamate and the fifth metacarpal.
desc.id: Otot fleksor superfisial paling medial, dengan caput humerale dari epicondylus medialis humeri dan caput ulnare dari olecranon serta margo posterior ulnae. N. ulnaris masuk ke lengan bawah melalui celah di antara kedua kepala tersebut. Tendonya berakhir pada os pisiforme, tulang sesamoid di dalam tendo ini, lalu berlanjut melalui ligamentum ke os hamatum dan os metacarpi V.

group.en: Anterior compartment of forearm, superficial layer (module: lapis pertama)
group.id: Otot regio antebrachii kompartemen anterior, lapis pertama (superfisial)

origin.la: Caput humerale: epicondylus medialis humeri; caput ulnare: margo medialis olecrani et margo posterior ulnae (per aponeurosin)
origin.en: Humeral head: medial epicondyle (common flexor origin). Ulnar head: medial margin of the olecranon and, through an aponeurosis, the posterior border of the ulna.

insertion.la: Os pisiforme; per ligamentum pisohamatum hamulus ossis hamati et per ligamentum pisometacarpale basis ossis metacarpi V
insertion.en: Pisiform, and through the pisohamate and pisometacarpal ligaments the hook of the hamate and the base of the fifth metacarpal

action.en: Flexes the hand at the wrist and adducts it (ulnar deviation). It also fixes the pisiform when abductor digiti minimi contracts.
action.id: Fleksi dan adduksi tangan pada pergelangan tangan (deviasi ulnar). Otot ini juga memfiksasi os pisiforme saat m. abductor digiti minimi berkontraksi.

clinical.en: The fibrous arch joining the two heads forms the roof of the cubital tunnel. Compression of the ulnar nerve here (cubital tunnel syndrome) causes tingling of the little finger and the medial half of the ring finger and weakness of the intrinsic hand muscles.
clinical.id: Lengkung fibrosa yang menghubungkan kedua kepala membentuk atap cubital tunnel. Penekanan n. ulnaris di tempat ini (sindrom cubital tunnel) menimbulkan kesemutan pada jari kelingking dan separuh medial jari manis serta kelemahan otot intrinsik tangan.

origin: Epicondylus medialis humeri et olecranon ulnae
epicondylus medialis humeri dan olecranon ulna
epicondylus medialis humeri, olecranon et margo posterior ulnae
caput humerale: epicondylus medialis; caput ulnare: olecranon dan margo posterior ulna
insertion: Os pisiforme, hamulus ossis hamati et basis ossis metacarpi V
pisiform, hamulus hamatum, dan basis metakarpal V
os pisiforme et os metacarpi V

la: Musculus flexor digiti minimi brevis pedis
alt: M. flexor digiti minimi brevis pedis
en: Flexor digiti minimi brevis of foot

desc.en: Small muscle of the third layer lying along the plantar surface of the fifth metatarsal, medial to abductor digiti minimi.
desc.id: Otot kecil lapisan ketiga yang terletak di sepanjang permukaan plantar os metatarsi V, di medial m. abductor digiti minimi.

origin.la: Basis ossis metatarsi V et vagina tendinis musculi fibularis longi
origin.en: Base of the fifth metatarsal and the sheath of the fibularis longus tendon

insertion.la: Basis phalangis proximalis digiti minimi
insertion.en: Base of the proximal phalanx of the fifth toe

action.en: Flexes the proximal phalanx of the little toe at the metatarsophalangeal joint.
action.id: Fleksi phalanx proximalis jari kelingking kaki pada sendi metatarsophalangea.

origin: basis metatarsal V dan os cuboideum
action: fleksi jari V pada sendi MTP

alt: Musculus flexor digiti minimi brevis manus
M. flexor digiti minimi brevis manus

desc.en: Hypothenar muscle lying lateral to abductor digiti minimi, from the hook of the hamate to the proximal phalanx of the little finger. It varies in size and may be fused with the abductor.
desc.id: Otot hypothenar di lateral m. abductor digiti minimi, dari hamulus ossis hamati ke phalanx proximalis jari kelingking. Ukurannya bervariasi dan dapat menyatu dengan m. abductor digiti minimi.

origin.la: Hamulus ossis hamati et retinaculum musculorum flexorum
origin.en: Hook of the hamate and the flexor retinaculum

insertion.la: Basis phalangis proximalis digiti minimi (latus mediale)
insertion.en: Medial side of the base of the proximal phalanx of the little finger

action.en: Flexes the proximal phalanx of the little finger at the metacarpophalangeal joint.
action.id: Fleksi phalanx proximalis jari kelingking pada sendi metacarpophalangea.

origin: Hamulus ossis hamati et retinaculum musculorum flexorum
action: fleksi jari kelingking pada sendi metacarpophalangeal

desc.en: Central muscle of the first layer of the sole, lying directly under the plantar aponeurosis. Its four tendons split near the proximal phalanges to let the flexor digitorum longus tendons through, as the superficial flexor does in the hand.
desc.id: Otot di bagian tengah lapisan pertama telapak kaki, tepat di bawah aponeurosis plantaris. Keempat tendonya bercabang dekat phalanx proximalis sehingga tendo m. flexor digitorum longus dapat lewat di antaranya, seperti m. flexor digitorum superficialis di tangan.

origin.la: Processus medialis tuberis calcanei, aponeurosis plantaris et septa intermuscularia
origin.en: Medial process of the calcaneal tuberosity, plantar aponeurosis and intermuscular septa

insertion.la: Latera phalangum mediarum digitorum II-V
insertion.en: Both sides of the middle phalanges of the lateral four toes

action.en: Flexes the lateral four toes at the proximal interphalangeal joints.
action.id: Fleksi jari kaki II-V pada sendi interphalangea proximalis.

note.en: The module puts it under 'kompartemen intermedial (lapisan dalam telapak kaki)'. It does lie in the central compartment, but it belongs to the first, most superficial layer of the sole.
note.id: Modul menempatkannya pada 'kompartemen intermedial (lapisan dalam telapak kaki)'. Otot ini memang berada di kompartemen sentral, tetapi termasuk lapisan pertama telapak kaki yang paling superfisial.

origin: Processus medialis tuberis calcanei et aponeurosis plantaris
action: fleksi jari II-V pada sendi PIP

desc.en: Deep calf muscle on the medial part of the posterior tibia. Its tendon passes behind the medial malleolus, crossing superficial to the tibialis posterior tendon in the leg and to the flexor hallucis longus tendon in the sole, then divides into four for the lateral toes.
desc.id: Otot betis profunda pada bagian medial permukaan posterior tibia. Tendonya berjalan di belakang malleolus medialis, menyilang di superfisial tendo m. tibialis posterior di tungkai bawah dan di superfisial tendo m. flexor hallucis longus di telapak kaki, lalu terbagi empat untuk jari II-V.

group.en: Posterior compartment of leg, deep group
group.id: Kompartemen posterior tungkai bawah, kelompok profunda

origin.la: Pars medialis faciei posterioris tibiae infra lineam musculi solei
origin.en: Medial part of the posterior surface of the tibia below the soleal line

insertion.la: Bases phalangum distalium digitorum II-V (facies plantaris)
insertion.en: Plantar surfaces of the bases of the distal phalanges of the lateral four toes

action.en: Flexes the lateral four toes, helps plantarflex the foot and supports the longitudinal arch. It lets the toes grip the ground in walking.
action.id: Fleksi jari kaki II-V, membantu plantarfleksi kaki dan menopang arcus longitudinalis. Otot ini membuat jari-jari kaki mencengkeram tanah saat berjalan.

desc.en: Thick muscle of the deep layer covering the front of the ulna. It is the only muscle that can flex the distal interphalangeal joints. Its four tendons run through the carpal tunnel deep to the superficialis tendons, give origin to the lumbricals in the palm and pass through the split superficialis tendons to the distal phalanges.
desc.id: Otot tebal pada lapisan dalam yang menutupi permukaan depan ulna. Otot ini satu-satunya yang dapat memfleksikan sendi interphalangea distalis. Keempat tendonya melalui canalis carpi di bawah tendo m. flexor digitorum superficialis, menjadi origo mm. lumbricales di telapak tangan, lalu menembus belahan tendo superficialis menuju phalanx distalis.

group.en: Anterior compartment of forearm, deep layer (module: lapis ketiga)
group.id: Otot regio antebrachii kompartemen anterior, lapis ketiga (profunda)

origin.la: Tres quartae proximales facierum medialis et anterioris ulnae et membrana interossea antebrachii
origin.en: Proximal three quarters of the medial and anterior surfaces of the ulna and the interosseous membrane

insertion.la: Bases phalangum distalium digitorum II-V (facies palmaris)
insertion.en: Palmar surface of the bases of the distal phalanges of digits 2-5

action.en: Flexes the distal phalanges at the distal interphalangeal joints of digits 2-5, then helps flex the more proximal finger joints and the hand at the wrist.
action.id: Fleksi phalanx distalis pada sendi interphalangea distalis jari II-V, kemudian membantu fleksi sendi-sendi jari yang lebih proksimal dan fleksi tangan pada pergelangan tangan.

nerve.la: Pars medialis (digiti IV-V): nervus ulnaris; pars lateralis (digiti II-III): nervus interosseus antebrachii anterior (nervus medianus)

clinical.en: The double nerve supply shows in lesions. An ulnar nerve injury at the elbow loses distal flexion of the ring and little fingers, while an anterior interosseous nerve lesion loses it in the index and middle fingers. To test the muscle, hold the middle phalanx still and ask the patient to bend the fingertip.
clinical.id: Persarafan ganda ini tampak pada lesi saraf. Cedera n. ulnaris setinggi siku menghilangkan fleksi distal jari manis dan kelingking, sedangkan lesi n. interosseus antebrachii anterior menghilangkannya pada jari telunjuk dan jari tengah. Untuk menguji otot ini, phalanx media ditahan lalu pasien diminta menekuk ujung jarinya.

origin: Facies anterior et medialis ulnae et membrana interossea
permukaan anterior ulna dan membrana interossea
nerve: N. medianus (n. interosseus anterior) dan n. ulnaris
N. ulnaris et N. interosseus antebrachii anterior
action: Flexio articulationum interphalangearum distalium digitorum II-V
fleksi sendi interphalangeal distal jari II-V

desc.en: Largest superficial muscle of the forearm and the only one in the intermediate layer. Its humero-ulnar and radial heads are joined by a fibrous arch, under which the median nerve and the ulnar artery pass. Its four tendons go through the carpal tunnel; at the proximal phalanx each splits into two slips that let the profundus tendon through, partly cross behind it and attach to the sides of the middle phalanx.
desc.id: Otot superfisial terbesar di lengan bawah dan satu-satunya otot pada lapisan tengah. Caput humeroulnare dan caput radiale dihubungkan oleh lengkung fibrosa yang dilewati n. medianus dan a. ulnaris. Keempat tendonya melalui canalis carpi; setinggi phalanx proximalis tiap tendo terbelah dua untuk dilewati tendo m. flexor digitorum profundus, sebagian saling menyilang di belakangnya (chiasma tendinum), lalu melekat pada sisi phalanx media.

group.en: Anterior compartment of forearm, intermediate layer (module: lapis kedua)
group.id: Otot regio antebrachii kompartemen anterior, lapis kedua (intermedia)

origin.la: Caput humeroulnare: epicondylus medialis humeri, ligamentum collaterale ulnare et processus coronoideus ulnae; caput radiale: dimidium proximale marginis anterioris radii
origin.en: Humero-ulnar head: medial epicondyle (common flexor origin), ulnar collateral ligament and coronoid process of the ulna. Radial head: upper half of the anterior border of the radius.

insertion.la: Latera corporum phalangum mediarum digitorum II-V
insertion.en: Sides of the shafts of the middle phalanges of the medial four digits

action.en: Flexes the middle phalanges at the proximal interphalangeal joints of digits 2-5. Acting more strongly, it also flexes the proximal phalanges at the metacarpophalangeal joints and the hand at the wrist.
action.id: Fleksi phalanx media pada sendi interphalangea proximalis jari II-V. Bila berkontraksi lebih kuat, otot ini juga memfleksikan phalanx proximalis pada sendi metacarpophalangea dan tangan pada pergelangan tangan.

clinical.en: To test it, hold the other fingers straight, which blocks flexor digitorum profundus because its tendons to the medial fingers share one belly, and ask the patient to bend the free finger. Flexion at the proximal interphalangeal joint with a floppy distal joint shows an intact superficialis tendon.
clinical.id: Untuk mengujinya, jari-jari lain ditahan lurus sehingga m. flexor digitorum profundus terhambat, karena tendonya untuk jari-jari medial berasal dari satu venter, lalu pasien diminta menekuk jari yang bebas. Fleksi pada sendi interphalangea proximalis dengan sendi distal yang lemas menunjukkan tendo m. flexor digitorum superficialis masih utuh.

note.en: The module gives the insertion as the tuberosity of the proximal phalanges. Standard references place it on the sides of the middle phalanges; the muscle has no attachment on the proximal phalanx.
note.id: Modul menyebut insersio pada tuberositas phalanx proximalis. Buku acuan standar menyebut sisi corpus phalanx media; otot ini tidak melekat pada phalanx proximalis.

origin: Epicondylus medialis humeri, processus coronoideus ulnae et radius
epicondylus medialis humeri, prosesus koronoideus ulna, dan bagian proksimal radius
caput humeroulnare: epicondylus medialis et processus coronoideus; caput radiale: margo anterior radii
action: Flexio articulationum interphalangearum proximalium digitorum II-V
fleksi sendi interphalangeal proksimal jari II-V

desc.en: Two-headed muscle in the third layer of the sole, lying along the first metatarsal. Each head ends on one side of the base of the proximal phalanx of the great toe with a sesamoid bone in its tendon, and the flexor hallucis longus tendon runs between them.
desc.id: Otot berkepala dua di lapisan ketiga telapak kaki yang terletak di sepanjang os metatarsi I. Tiap kepala berinsersio pada satu sisi basis phalanx proximalis ibu jari kaki dengan sebuah os sesamoideum di dalam tendonya, dan tendo m. flexor hallucis longus berjalan di antara keduanya.

origin.la: Facies plantaris ossis cuboidei et ossis cuneiformis lateralis
origin.en: Plantar surfaces of the cuboid and lateral cuneiform

insertion.la: Latera basis phalangis proximalis hallucis (per ossa sesamoidea)
insertion.en: Both sides of the base of the proximal phalanx of the great toe, through the two sesamoid bones

action.en: Flexes the proximal phalanx of the great toe at the metatarsophalangeal joint.
action.id: Fleksi phalanx proximalis ibu jari kaki pada sendi metatarsophalangea.

origin: Os cuboideum et os cuneiforme laterale
insertion: Basis phalangis proximalis hallucis (per ossa sesamoidea)
action: fleksi ibu jari kaki pada sendi MTP

desc.en: Most powerful of the deep calf muscles, lying on the posterior surface of the fibula. Its tendon grooves the back of the talus, runs under the sustentaculum tali and passes between the two sesamoids of the great toe. It gives the final push from the great toe at toe-off.
desc.id: Otot terkuat di antara otot betis profunda, terletak pada permukaan posterior fibula. Tendonya menempati sulcus di bagian belakang talus, berjalan di bawah sustentaculum tali, lalu lewat di antara kedua os sesamoideum ibu jari kaki. Otot ini memberi dorongan terakhir dari ibu jari kaki saat toe-off.

group.en: Posterior compartment of leg, deep group
group.id: Kompartemen posterior tungkai bawah, kelompok profunda

origin.la: Duae tertiae inferiores faciei posterioris fibulae et pars inferior membranae interosseae cruris
origin.en: Lower two-thirds of the posterior surface of the fibula and the lower part of the interosseous membrane

insertion.la: Basis phalangis distalis hallucis (facies plantaris)
insertion.en: Plantar surface of the base of the distal phalanx of the great toe

action.en: Flexes the great toe at all its joints and weakly plantarflexes the foot. It supports the medial longitudinal arch and gives the push-off at toe-off in walking and running.
action.id: Fleksi ibu jari kaki pada semua sendinya dan plantarfleksi lemah kaki. Otot ini menopang arcus longitudinalis medialis dan memberi dorongan saat toe-off ketika berjalan atau berlari.

desc.en: Thenar muscle lying medial to abductor pollicis brevis, with a superficial head from the flexor retinaculum and a deep head from the distal carpal bones. It flexes the proximal phalanx of the thumb. The two heads often have different nerves: the median nerve for the superficial head and the ulnar nerve for the deep head.
desc.id: Otot thenar di medial m. abductor pollicis brevis, dengan caput superficiale dari retinaculum musculorum flexorum dan caput profundum dari ossa carpi baris distal. Otot ini memfleksikan phalanx proximalis ibu jari. Kedua kepalanya sering memiliki persarafan berbeda: n. medianus untuk caput superficiale dan n. ulnaris untuk caput profundum.

origin.la: Caput superficiale: retinaculum musculorum flexorum et tuberculum ossis trapezii; caput profundum: os trapezoideum et os capitatum
origin.en: Superficial head: flexor retinaculum and tubercle of the trapezium. Deep head: trapezoid and capitate.

insertion.la: Basis phalangis proximalis pollicis (latus laterale), per os sesamoideum laterale
insertion.en: Lateral side of the base of the proximal phalanx of the thumb, through the lateral sesamoid bone

action.en: Flexes the thumb at the metacarpophalangeal joint and helps flex the carpometacarpal joint during opposition.
action.id: Fleksi ibu jari pada sendi metacarpophalangea dan membantu fleksi sendi carpometacarpalis saat oposisi.

nerve.la: Caput superficiale: ramus recurrens nervi mediani; caput profundum: ramus profundus nervi ulnaris

origin: Retinaculum musculorum flexorum et os trapezium
retinaculum flexorum dan tuberculum ossis trapezii
caput superficiale: retinaculum flexorum; caput profundum: os trapezoideum et os capitatum
nerve: Ramus recurrens nervi mediani et ramus profundus nervi ulnaris
action: fleksi ibu jari pada sendi metacarpophalangeal

desc.en: Deep flexor lying lateral to flexor digitorum profundus on the front of the radius. Its tendon runs through the carpal tunnel in its own synovial sheath and between the thenar muscles to the distal phalanx of the thumb. It is the only muscle that flexes the interphalangeal joint of the thumb.
desc.id: Otot fleksor dalam di lateral m. flexor digitorum profundus, pada permukaan depan radius. Tendonya melalui canalis carpi dalam selubung sinovialnya sendiri dan berjalan di antara otot thenar menuju phalanx distalis ibu jari. Otot ini satu-satunya yang memfleksikan sendi interphalangea ibu jari.

group.en: Anterior compartment of forearm, deep layer (module: lapis ketiga)
group.id: Otot regio antebrachii kompartemen anterior, lapis ketiga (profunda)

origin.la: Facies anterior radii et membrana interossea antebrachii
origin.en: Anterior surface of the radius and the adjacent interosseous membrane

insertion.la: Basis phalangis distalis pollicis (facies palmaris)
insertion.en: Palmar surface of the base of the distal phalanx of the thumb

action.en: Flexes the distal phalanx of the thumb at the interphalangeal joint, then helps flex the metacarpophalangeal and carpometacarpal joints of the thumb, and weakly the wrist.
action.id: Fleksi phalanx distalis ibu jari pada sendi interphalangea, kemudian membantu fleksi sendi metacarpophalangea dan carpometacarpalis ibu jari, serta fleksi lemah pergelangan tangan.

clinical.en: In anterior interosseous nerve palsy the patient cannot make a round 'OK' sign. The tip of the thumb and the tip of the index finger cannot bend, so the pinch becomes flat, pad to pad.
clinical.id: Pada kelumpuhan n. interosseus antebrachii anterior, pasien tidak dapat membentuk tanda 'OK' yang bulat. Ujung ibu jari dan ujung jari telunjuk tidak dapat ditekuk, sehingga jepitan menjadi datar, bantalan bertemu bantalan.

note.en: The module names this muscle 'm. pollicis longus', leaving out 'flexor', and lists flexion of the 'distal interphalangeal' joint of the thumb. The thumb has two phalanges and a single interphalangeal joint.
note.id: Modul menulis nama otot ini sebagai 'm. pollicis longus' tanpa kata 'flexor', dan menyebut fleksi sendi 'interphalangeal distal' ibu jari. Ibu jari hanya memiliki dua phalanx dan satu sendi interphalangea.

origin: Facies anterior radii et membrana interossea
permukaan anterior radius dan membrana interossea

desc.en: Band of deep fascia stretched from the medial malleolus to the medial process of the calcaneal tuberosity, forming the roof of the tarsal tunnel. Beneath it, from front to back, pass the tibialis posterior and flexor digitorum longus tendons, the posterior tibial vessels, the tibial nerve and the flexor hallucis longus tendon.
desc.id: Pita fascia profunda yang terbentang dari malleolus medialis ke processus medialis tuberis calcanei dan membentuk atap terowongan tarsal. Di bawahnya, dari depan ke belakang, berjalan tendo m. tibialis posterior dan m. flexor digitorum longus, vasa tibialis posterior, n. tibialis dan tendo m. flexor hallucis longus.

location.en: Medial side of the ankle, behind the medial malleolus
location.id: Sisi medial pergelangan kaki, di belakang malleolus medialis

attach.en: Medial malleolus to the medial process of the calcaneal tuberosity
attach.id: Malleolus medialis ke processus medialis tuberis calcanei

clinical.en: Compression of the tibial nerve or its plantar branches under the retinaculum causes burning pain and numbness in the sole (tarsal tunnel syndrome).
clinical.id: Penekanan n. tibialis atau cabang-cabang plantarnya di bawah retinaculum ini menimbulkan nyeri seperti terbakar dan baal di telapak kaki (sindrom terowongan tarsal).

desc.en: Thick fibrous band bridging the front of the carpal arch, attached medially to the pisiform and the hook of the hamate and laterally to the tubercles of the scaphoid and trapezium. It turns the hollow of the carpus into the carpal tunnel and gives origin to most of the thenar and hypothenar muscles.
desc.id: Pita fibrosa tebal yang menjembatani bagian depan lengkung ossa carpi, melekat di medial pada os pisiforme dan hamulus ossis hamati serta di lateral pada tuberculum ossis scaphoidei dan tuberculum ossis trapezii. Retinaculum ini mengubah cekungan ossa carpi menjadi canalis carpi dan menjadi origo sebagian besar otot thenar dan hypothenar.

attach.en: Medially the pisiform and hook of the hamate; laterally the tubercles of the scaphoid and trapezium
attach.id: Di medial os pisiforme dan hamulus ossis hamati; di lateral tuberculum ossis scaphoidei dan tuberculum ossis trapezii

function.en: Forms the roof of the carpal tunnel and holds the long flexor tendons against the carpus. The tendon of flexor carpi radialis runs in a separate split of its lateral part; palmaris longus, the ulnar nerve and artery and the palmar branch of the median nerve pass in front of it.
function.id: Membentuk atap canalis carpi dan menahan tendo fleksor panjang tetap menempel pada ossa carpi. Tendo m. flexor carpi radialis berjalan dalam celah tersendiri di bagian lateralnya; m. palmaris longus, n. ulnaris, a. ulnaris dan r. palmaris n. mediani lewat di depannya.

clinical.en: Anything that narrows the carpal tunnel, such as swollen tendon sheaths, fluid retention in pregnancy, arthritis or a fracture, compresses the median nerve (carpal tunnel syndrome). Patients have tingling and numbness in the lateral three and a half digits, worse at night, then thenar weakness and wasting; the skin of the central palm is spared because the palmar branch of the median nerve runs superficial to the retinaculum. Dividing the retinaculum relieves the pressure.
clinical.id: Segala hal yang menyempitkan canalis carpi, misalnya selubung tendo yang membengkak, retensi cairan saat hamil, artritis atau fraktur, menekan n. medianus (sindrom carpal tunnel). Pasien mengeluh kesemutan dan kebas pada tiga setengah jari lateral yang memberat pada malam hari, lalu timbul kelemahan dan atrofi otot thenar; kulit bagian tengah telapak tangan tidak terganggu karena r. palmaris n. mediani berjalan di superfisial retinaculum. Pemotongan retinaculum menghilangkan tekanan tersebut.

desc.en: A small blind pit at the lower end of the frontal crest, just in front of the crista galli; in children it may carry an emissary vein from the nasal cavity to the superior sagittal sinus.
desc.id: Lubang kecil yang buntu di ujung bawah crista frontalis, tepat di depan crista galli; pada anak dapat dilalui vena emissaria dari cavitas nasi ke sinus sagittalis superior.

desc.en: The large opening where the medulla oblongata continues as the spinal cord; it also carries the vertebral arteries, the spinal roots of the accessory nerves and the meninges.
desc.id: Lubang besar tempat medulla oblongata berlanjut menjadi medulla spinalis; juga dilalui aa. vertebrales, radix spinalis n. accessorius, dan meninges.

desc.en: An oval opening in the greater wing that carries the mandibular nerve (V3), the accessory meningeal artery and sometimes the lesser petrosal nerve.
desc.id: Lubang lonjong pada ala major yang dilalui n. mandibularis (V3), a. meningea accessoria, dan kadang n. petrosus minor.

desc.en: A round canal at the root of the greater wing that carries the maxillary nerve (V2) from the middle cranial fossa to the pterygopalatine fossa.
desc.id: Saluran bulat di pangkal ala major yang dilalui n. maxillaris (V2) dari fossa cranii media ke fossa pterygopalatina.

desc.en: A small opening behind the foramen ovale for the middle meningeal artery and vein and the meningeal branch of the mandibular nerve.
desc.id: Lubang kecil di belakang foramen ovale untuk a. dan v. meningea media serta ramus meningeus n. mandibularis.

desc.en: The opening in the transverse process of every cervical vertebra. The vertebral artery, its veins and sympathetic plexus pass up through those of C6 to C1; the small foramen of C7 usually carries only accessory veins.
desc.id: Lubang pada processus transversus setiap vertebra cervicalis. A. vertebralis beserta venanya dan plexus sympathicus naik melalui foramen C6 sampai C1; foramen C7 yang kecil biasanya hanya dilalui vena accessoria.

clinical.en: This foramen identifies a cervical vertebra at a glance.
clinical.id: Foramen ini menjadi ciri pengenal vertebra cervicalis.

desc.en: A shallow hollow in the anterolateral part of the orbital roof, behind the zygomatic process, that holds the orbital part of the lacrimal gland.
desc.id: Cekungan dangkal di bagian anterolateral atap orbita, di belakang processus zygomaticus, tempat pars orbitalis glandula lacrimalis.

desc.en: Metacarpal of the ring finger, thinner and shorter than the third. Its base articulates with the capitate and hamate, and its carpometacarpal joint moves more than those of the second and third metacarpals.
desc.id: Os metacarpi jari manis, lebih tipis dan lebih pendek daripada metacarpal III. Basisnya bersendi dengan os capitatum dan os hamatum, dan sendi carpometacarpalisnya lebih mudah bergerak dibanding metacarpal II dan III.

note.en: Shaft: third and fourth dorsal interossei and the second palmar interosseous.
note.id: Corpus: m. interosseus dorsalis III dan IV serta m. interosseus palmaris II.

desc.en: Its base articulates with the cuboid behind, with the lateral cuneiform, and with the third and fifth metatarsals at the sides.
desc.id: Basisnya bersendi dengan os cuboideum di belakang, dengan os cuneiforme laterale, serta dengan os metatarsi III dan V di sampingnya.

desc.en: A typical true rib articulating with T3 and T4. In men the nipple usually lies over the fourth intercostal space, just below this rib, in the midclavicular line.
desc.id: Costa vera tipikal yang bersendi dengan T3 dan T4. Pada laki-laki papilla mammae biasanya terletak di atas spatium intercostale IV, tepat di bawah costa ini, pada linea medioclavicularis.

en: Fovea for ligament of head of femur

desc.en: Small pit just below and behind the centre of the femoral head, the only part of the head without cartilage.
desc.id: Lekukan kecil sedikit di bawah belakang pusat caput femoris, satu-satunya bagian caput yang tidak dilapisi rawan sendi.

attach.en: Ligament of the head of the femur, which carries a small artery to the head.
attach.id: Lig. capitis femoris yang membawa arteri kecil ke caput femoris.

desc.en: Longitudinal folds of synovial membrane and deep capsular fibres reflected back along the femoral neck from the distal attachment of the capsule.
desc.id: Lipatan longitudinal membrana synovialis dan serabut kapsul bagian dalam yang membalik ke arah proksimal di sepanjang collum femoris dari perlekatan distal capsula.

attach.en: From the distal capsular attachment on the neck toward the margin of the femoral head.
attach.id: Dari perlekatan distal capsula pada collum ke arah tepi caput femoris.

function.en: They carry the retinacular arteries, mainly from the medial circumflex femoral artery, that supply the head and neck of the femur.
function.id: Membawa arteri retinakular, terutama dari a. circumflexa femoris medialis, yang memperdarahi caput dan collum femoris.

desc.en: The anterosuperior corner at the bregma, where the coronal and sagittal sutures meet; the anterior fontanelle lies here in infants.
desc.id: Sudut anterosuperior di bregma, pertemuan sutura coronalis dan sagittalis; pada bayi di sini terdapat fonticulus anterior.

desc.en: The unpaired bone of the forehead and the front of the cranial vault. Its squama forms the forehead, its orbital parts form most of the orbital roofs and the floor of the anterior cranial fossa, and it contains the frontal sinuses. At birth it is in two halves joined by the frontal (metopic) suture, which usually closes in early childhood.
desc.id: Tulang tunggal yang membentuk dahi dan bagian depan atap tengkorak. Squama frontalis membentuk dahi, pars orbitalis membentuk sebagian besar atap orbita dan dasar fossa cranii anterior, dan di dalamnya terdapat sinus frontalis. Saat lahir tulang ini terdiri atas dua belahan yang disatukan sutura frontalis (metopica), yang biasanya menutup pada awal masa kanak-kanak.

desc.en: The anterior border that meets the frontal bone at the coronal suture.
desc.id: Tepi depan yang bertemu os frontale pada sutura coronalis.

desc.en: A midline ridge on the inner surface of the frontal bone, above the foramen caecum; the falx cerebri attaches to it.
desc.id: Rigi di garis tengah permukaan dalam os frontale, di atas foramen caecum; tempat melekat falx cerebri.

desc.en: A rounded prominence on each side of the forehead above the supraorbital margin, marking the ossification centre of each half of the frontal bone.
desc.id: Tonjolan bulat di kiri dan kanan dahi di atas margo supraorbitalis, bekas pusat penulangan tiap belahan os frontale.

desc.en: The serrated upper margin of the greater wing that articulates with the frontal bone.
desc.id: Tepi atas ala major yang bergerigi, bersendi dengan os frontale.

desc.en: The curved upper rim of the orbit, formed by the frontal bone, with the supraorbital notch or foramen at the junction of its medial and middle thirds.
desc.id: Tepi atas orbita yang dibentuk os frontale; incisura atau foramen supraorbitale terletak di perbatasan sepertiga medial dan tengahnya.

desc.en: Paired sinuses in the frontal bone behind the superciliary arches, separated by a thin septum. Each drains through the ductus frontonasalis (infundibulum ethmoidale) into the hiatus semilunaris of the meatus nasi medius.
desc.id: Sinus berpasangan di dalam os frontale di belakang arcus superciliaris, dipisahkan oleh septum tipis. Masing-masing bermuara melalui ductus frontonasalis (infundibulum ethmoidale) ke hiatus semilunaris di meatus nasi medius.

desc.en: Most superficial muscle of the calf, with two heads from the femoral condyles that form the lower borders of the popliteal fossa. It crosses both knee and ankle and is the main calf muscle for fast movements such as running and jumping.
desc.id: Otot betis yang paling superfisial, dengan dua kepala dari condylus femoris yang membentuk batas bawah fossa poplitea. Otot ini menyilang sendi lutut dan pergelangan kaki, dan merupakan otot betis utama untuk gerakan cepat seperti berlari dan melompat.

group.en: Posterior compartment of leg, superficial group (triceps surae)
group.id: Kompartemen posterior tungkai bawah, kelompok superfisial (m. triceps surae)

origin.la: Caput laterale: facies lateralis condyli lateralis femoris; caput mediale: facies poplitea femoris supra condylum medialem
origin.en: Lateral head: lateral aspect of the lateral femoral condyle. Medial head: popliteal surface of the femur just above the medial condyle.

insertion.la: Facies posterior tuberis calcanei (per tendinem calcaneum)
insertion.en: Posterior surface of the calcaneus, through the calcaneal tendon

action.en: Plantarflexes the foot at the ankle, lifting the heel in walking and running. It also flexes the knee, and its pull on the ankle weakens when the knee is flexed.
action.id: Plantarfleksi kaki pada sendi talocruralis, mengangkat tumit saat berjalan dan berlari. Otot ini juga melakukan fleksi lutut, dan tarikannya pada pergelangan kaki melemah bila lutut dalam posisi fleksi.

clinical.en: A sudden push-off can tear the medial head where it joins the tendon ('tennis leg'), causing sharp pain in the middle of the calf.
clinical.id: Tolakan mendadak dapat merobek caput mediale pada perbatasannya dengan tendo ('tennis leg'), menimbulkan nyeri tajam di pertengahan betis.

desc.en: Venae comitantes of the genicular arteries around the knee. They drain the knee joint and the tissues around it and end in v. poplitea.
desc.id: Venae comitantes dari arteri-arteri genus di sekitar lutut. Vena ini mengalirkan darah dari sendi lutut dan jaringan di sekitarnya lalu bermuara ke v. poplitea.

drains.en: The capsule and synovial membrane of the knee joint, the distal femur, the proximal tibia and the patella, through veins that follow the superior, middle and inferior genicular arteries.
drains.id: Capsula articularis dan membrana synovialis sendi lutut, femur distal, tibia proksimal dan patella, melalui vena yang mengikuti aa. genus superior, media dan inferior.

desc.en: A craniometric point at the tip of the mental spines on the inner surface of the mandible, in the midline.
desc.id: Titik kraniometri pada ujung spina mentalis di permukaan dalam mandibula, tepat di garis tengah.

desc.en: Enters the canalis inguinalis through the anulus inguinalis profundus, runs with the funiculus spermaticus (or ligamentum teres uteri), and supplies m. cremaster and the skin of the anterior scrotum or labium majus.
